title: Claude Code plugin monitors/monitors.json
description: Complete skeleton of a plugin's monitors/monitors.json: background processes whose stdout lines reach Claude as notifications. Mirrors the official plugins reference; no repo-specific policy.
$comment: Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference#monitors (verified 2026-09-18 against Claude Code 2.1.277). Declared in plugin.json under experimental.monitors. Commands may use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}, ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} and env vars, but never ${user_config.*}.

name.description: Unique within the plugin; prevents duplicate processes on reload.

command.description: Persistent background shell command run in the session working directory.

description.description: Shown in the task panel and notification summaries.
